templates.prompt:
Quantity I: SI on ₹{P:inr} at {r}% p.a. for 2 years
Quantity II: CI on ₹{P2:inr} at {r2}% p.a. for 2 years

Quantity I: speed (km/h) of a train {L} m long that crosses a pole in {t} s
Quantity II: {v} km/h

Quantity I: profit % when CP = ₹{CP:inr} and SP = ₹{SP:inr}
Quantity II: {x}%
templates.solution:
Profit = {SP:inr} − {CP:inr}; % = profit ÷ CP × 100 = {q1}%
Quantity II: {q2}%

templates.prompt:
Quantity I: A's share when ₹{T:inr} is divided between A and B in the ratio {a} : {b}
Quantity II: ₹{y:inr}
templates.solution:
A's share = {T:inr} × {a}/({a} + {b}) = {q1}
Quantity II: {q2}

templates.prompt:
In a school of {N} students, {p}% are girls. {q}% of the girls and {s}% of the boys passed.
Total students who passed = ?
templates.solution:
Girls = {p}% of {N} = {g}; boys = {N} − {g} = {b}
Passed = {q}% of {g} + {s}% of {b} = {answer}

B's 2024 figure = {d}; A's 2023 figure = {a}
{d} ÷ {a} × 100 = {answer}%

templates.prompt:
A shopkeeper marks an article at ₹{MP:inr}, gives a {d}% discount and still gains {g}%.
Cost price = ?
If a + 1/a = {k}, then a⁴ + 1/a⁴ = ?
templates.solution:
a² + 1/a² = {k}² − 2
a⁴ + 1/a⁴ = (a² + 1/a²)² − 2 = {answer}

templates.prompt: If a + b = {s} and a − b = {d}, then ab = ?
templates.solution:
ab = [(a + b)² − (a − b)²] / 4
= ({s}² − {d}²) / 4 = {answer}

templates.prompt: Sum of all two-digit numbers divisible by {d} = ?
templates.solution:
Two-digit multiples of {d}: {f}, …, {l} — {n} terms in AP
Sum = {n} × ({f} + {l}) / 2 = {answer}

templates.prompt:
A can do a work in {a} days and B in {b} days. Working together they earn ₹{W:inr}.
A's share = ?
templates.solution:
Wages ∝ daily work: A : B = 1/{a} : 1/{b} = {b} : {a}
A's share = {W:inr} × {b}/({a} + {b}) = ₹{answer:inr}

templates.prompt:
The average age of a husband and wife was {x} years when they married. {n} years later they have a {c}-year-old child.
Average age of the family now = ?
templates.solution:
Couple's total now = 2 × ({x} + {n})
Family average = (2 × ({x} + {n}) + {c}) / 3 = {answer}

templates.prompt:
In an election between two candidates, the winner gets {p}% of the votes and wins by {d:inr} votes.
Total votes = ?
templates.solution:
Margin = winner% − loser% = (2 × {p} − 100)% of all votes
Total = {d:inr} × 100 / (2 × {p} − 100) = {answer:inr}

templates.prompt:
A student needs {p}% to pass. He scores {g} marks and fails by {f} marks.
Maximum marks = ?
templates.solution:
Pass mark = {g} + {f} = {need}
{need} is {p}% of the maximum → {need} × 100 / {p} = {answer}

templates.prompt:
A man spends {e}% of his income. His income rises by {a}% and his expenditure by {b}%.
By what % do his savings increase?

Two articles are sold for ₹{S:inr} each — one at {p}% profit, the other at {p}% loss.
Overall loss % = ?
templates.solution:
Same SP with equal % profit and loss → loss % = p²/100
= {p}² / 100 = {answer}%

templates.prompt:
The cost price of {a} articles equals the selling price of {b} articles.
Profit % = ?
templates.solution:
CP of {a} = SP of {b} → gain of {a} − {b} articles on {b}
Profit % = ({a} − {b}) / {b} × 100 = {answer}%

templates.prompt:
A sum amounts to ₹{A2:inr} in 2 years and ₹{A3:inr} in 3 years at compound interest.
Rate % p.a. = ?
templates.solution:
One year's interest on {A2:inr} = {A3:inr} − {A2:inr}
Rate = that ÷ {A2:inr} × 100 = {answer}%

templates.prompt: At simple interest a sum doubles in {n} years. In how many years will it become {k} times?
templates.solution:
Doubling: interest = 1 × principal in {n} years
{k} times needs ({k} − 1) × principal → ({k} − 1) × {n} = {answer} years

templates.prompt:
A bag has ₹1, 50p and 25p coins in the ratio {a} : {b} : {c}, worth ₹{T:inr} in all.
Number of 25p coins = ?
{m1} men can finish a work in {d1} days. In how many days will {m2} men finish it?
templates.solution:
M₁D₁ = M₂D₂ → {m1} × {d1} = {m2} × D
D = {answer} days

templates.prompt:
{m1} men working {h1} hours a day finish a work in {d1} days.
How many days will {m2} men working {h2} hours a day take?
templates.solution:
M₁H₁D₁ = M₂H₂D₂ → {m1} × {h1} × {d1} = {m2} × {h2} × D
D = {answer} days

templates.prompt: A is {p}% more efficient than B. B alone takes {b} days. A alone takes ? days
templates.solution:
Time ∝ 1/efficiency
A = {b} × 100 / (100 + {p}) = {answer} days

templates.prompt:
A train passes a pole in {t1} s and a {P} m long platform in {t2} s.
Length of the train (m) = ?
templates.solution:
The extra {t2} − {t1} s covers the {P} m platform
Speed = {P} ÷ ({t2} − {t1}) = {v} m/s
Length = {v} × {t1} = {answer} m

templates.prompt:
Walking at {v1} km/h a man is {l} minutes late; at {v2} km/h he is {e} minutes early.
Distance (km) = ?
templates.solution:
Time difference = {l} + {e} minutes
d/{v1} − d/{v2} = ({l} + {e})/60
d = {answer} km

templates.prompt: A batsman's average after {n} innings is {a}. How many runs must he score in the next innings to raise it to {b}?
templates.solution:
Total needed = {b} × ({n} + 1); current total = {a} × {n}
Runs needed = {answer}

templates.prompt:
The average of {n} numbers was {a}, but {x} was wrongly read as {y}.
Correct average = ?
templates.solution:
Correct total = {n} × {a} − {y} + {x}
Correct average = that ÷ {n} = {answer}

templates.prompt:
A {l} m × {b} m garden has a {w} m wide path around it on the outside.
Area of the path (m²) = ?
templates.solution:
Outer rectangle = ({l} + 2 × {w}) × ({b} + 2 × {w})
Path = outer − {l} × {b} = {answer} m²

templates.prompt: Cost of fencing a {l} m × {b} m field at ₹{r} per metre = ?
templates.solution:
Perimeter = 2({l} + {b}) m
Cost = perimeter × ₹{r} = ₹{answer:inr}

templates.prompt: Area of a sector of radius {r} cm and angle {t}° (use π = 22/7) = ? (cm²)
templates.solution:
Sector = θ/360 × πr² = {t}/360 × 22/7 × {r}²
= {answer} cm²

templates.prompt: The angles of a triangle are in the ratio {a} : {b} : {c}. The largest angle (°) = ?
templates.solution:
Ratio parts add to {a} + {b} + {c}; each part = 180 ÷ that
Largest angle = {answer}°

templates.prompt:
The sum of the ages of a mother and her daughter is {S}. After {n} years the mother will be {k} times as old as the daughter.
Daughter's present age = ?
templates.solution:
Daughter = d, mother = {S} − d
{S} − d + {n} = {k}(d + {n}) → d = {answer}

templates.prompt:
Vessel A has milk and water in the ratio {a} : {b}, vessel B in {c} : {d}. {x} L of A is mixed with {y} L of B.
Milk in the mixture (L) = ?
templates.answer: x * a / (a + b) + y * c / (c + d)
templates.solution:
Milk from A = {x} × {a}/({a} + {b}); from B = {y} × {c}/({c} + {d})
Total milk = {answer} L

templates.prompt:
A invests ₹{A:inr} and B ₹{B:inr}. After {m} months A withdraws half his capital. The year's profit is ₹{P:inr}.
A's share = ?

Three bells ring at intervals of {a}, {b} and {c} minutes. They ring together at 9 a.m.
After how many minutes will they next ring together?
templates.solution:
They ring together every LCM({a}, {b}, {c}) minutes
= {answer}

templates.prompt:
Quantity I: the larger root of x² − {s}x + {pr} = 0
Quantity II: {v}
templates.solution:
x² − {s}x + {pr} = (x − {r1})(x − {r2})
Larger root = {q1}; Quantity II = {q2}

templates.prompt:
Quantity I: average of the first {n} even numbers
Quantity II: {v}
templates.solution:
Average of the first n even numbers = n + 1 = {q1}
Quantity II = {q2}

templates.prompt:
Quantity I: CI − SI on ₹{P:inr} at {r}% p.a. for 2 years
Quantity II: ₹{v:inr}
templates.solution:
CI − SI for 2 years = P(r/100)² = {P:inr} × ({r}/100)² = {q1}
Quantity II = {q2}

templates.prompt: Two numbers are in the ratio {a} : {b} and their LCM is {L}. Their sum = ?
In an AP the 3rd term is {p} and the 9th term is {q}. The 15th term = ?
templates.solution:
T₉ − T₃ = 6d → d = ({q} − {p}) / 6 = {dd}
T₁₅ = T₉ + 6d = {q} + 6 × {dd} = {answer}

templates.prompt:
A and B together finish a job in {x} days, B and C in {y} days, C and A in {z} days.
All three together finish it in ? days

let.W: lcm(lcm(ra + rb, rb + rc), lcm(rc + ra, ra + rb + rc))

templates.prompt:
Two cars start at the same time from P and Q, {D} km apart, towards each other at {u} km/h and {v} km/h.
They meet how far from P (km)?
templates.solution:
Time to meet = {D} ÷ ({u} + {v}) = {k} h
Distance from P = {u} × {k} = {answer} km

templates.prompt:
Alloy P is {g1}% gold and alloy Q is {g2}% gold. They are melted together in the ratio {x} : {y}.
Gold % in the new alloy = ?
templates.solution:
Weighted average: ({x} × {g1} + {y} × {g2}) / ({x} + {y})
= {answer}%

templates.prompt: If log₂ x + log₂ (x − {k}) = {m} and x > {k}, then x = ?
A square is inscribed in a circle of radius {r} cm. Area of the square (cm²) = ?
templates.solution:
The square's diagonal = diameter = 2 × {r}
Area = diagonal² / 2 = (2 × {r})² / 2 = {answer}
